notes.title: January 5, 2022 Application updated.
notes.notes:
Thank you very much for playing "Pixel Game Maker Series MEDIUM-NAUT".
January 5, 2022 Application updated.
The updated contents are as follows.


*Fixed a bug.
If you save the game while holding the event item "Balloon" that can be obtained at the restaurant, the save data will crash.

You cannot load saved data that already has a problem.


*Adjustments to content
The default option on the title screen has been changed to "Continue".
Other adjustments such as weapon strength and enemy placement.


We apologize for any inconvenience caused by this problem.

currently working on a fix, so please be patient.

[Updated on Jan. 5, 2022]
The following bug has been fixed in the 1/5 update.
We apologize for any inconvenience caused by this bug.


[strike]*Symptoms of malfunction
If you save the game while holding the "balloon" event item available at the restaurant, the save data will crash.

*workaround
Do not save while in possession of a "balloon".

If you save the game with the "balloon" in your hand, you can avoid this by saving the game again after the event when you are without the "balloon".[/strike]

The protagonist is a psychic medium.
A sci-fi horror action game where you investigate an incident that occurred on a spaceship that crashed on an uncharted planet, communicating with the souls of the crew to uncover the truth behind the incident!
